gates.rationale: v1 gates only evaluate good_or_acceptable and require surprising_or_useful to remain excluded.
gates.title: Target Scope

gates.rationale: The ranker experiment must prove it followed the split policy and wrote no production artifact.
gates.title: Policy Compliance

gates.rationale: No canonical work may appear in both train and eval folds.
gates.title: Zero Work Leakage

gates.rationale: Grouped CV needs at least two positive and two negative canonical work groups.
gates.title: Minimum Work Groups

gates.rationale: The audit experiment needs enough observations and grouped positives/negatives to be worth interpreting.
gates.title: Class Balance Floor

gates.rationale: The embedding classifier must clear the trivial majority baseline by a meaningful balanced-accuracy margin.
gates.title: Majority Baseline Margin

gates.rationale: Every fold must produce evaluable ROC-AUC above the audit threshold.
gates.title: ROC-AUC Floor

gates.rationale: The embedding classifier must produce strong precision-recall ranking signal on audit folds.
gates.title: Average Precision Floor

gates.rationale: Audit performance must be reasonably stable across grouped folds.
gates.title: Fold Stability

gates.rationale: Duplicate/conflicting observations may exist; this gate only checks that their pressure is visible.
gates.title: Duplicate Pressure Reported

gates.advisory_text: High audit-pool CV metrics do not imply product-candidate or live ranking success.
gates.rationale: The input is a mixed audit-pool experiment, not a product-candidate ranking experiment.
gates.title: Audit Pool Scope Acknowledged

gates.next_action: run production-candidate offline scoring experiment before shadow scoring
gates.rationale: Product-shaped candidate pool and ranking-relevant workflow metrics have not been measured by this audit experiment.
gates.title: Product-Candidate Experiment Required

gates.rationale: Audit gates may advance offline research only when the production plan still blocks production eligibility.
gates.title: Production Readiness Plan Alignment
